Talent0_2Ability.name: 完美主义
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: 可以使用<skill mainSkill=400750>[强磁力线圈]</skill>指令，然后可继续行动，每回合最多使用<color=#F74848>1</color>次

Talent3_5Ability.name: 完美主义
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
可以使用<skill mainSkill=400750>[强磁力线圈]</skill>指令，然后可继续行动，每回合最多使用<color=#F74848>1</color>次；
电磁炮的弹仓容量<color=#F74848>+2</color>

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

400702.name: 交响打击
400702.SpecificEffects: 主动攻击时每打击<color=#F74848>1</color>个目标，本次攻击伤害提升<color=#F74848>5%</color>，最多提升<color=#F74848>20%</color>

400703.name: 电磁协奏
400703.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900086>[偏移]</buf>后的攻击额外提升<color=#F74848>0.25</color>倍的伤害

400704.name: 震噪
400704.describe: 使用电磁炮攻击<range type=1>纵向5格</range>范围内所有目标，造成<color=#F74848>1</color>倍范围伤害，对命中的目标施加<buf ID=1004021>[武器阻碍]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>1</color>回合

400705.name: 幕歇
400705.describe: 使电磁炮的弹数完全回复，并获得<buf ID=7100901>[移动力提升]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>1</color>回合，然后可使用剩余移动力继续行动

400706.name: 强音咏叹
400706.describe: 消耗<color=#F74848>2</color>发弹药，使用电磁炮攻击<range type=1>纵向3×5格</range>范围内所有目标，造成<color=#F74848>0.85</color>倍范围伤害，命中耐久值最低部位的权重提升<color=#F74848>50</color>

400707.name: 连奏
400707.SpecificEffects: 发动<buf ID=900004>[再攻击]</buf>时，使刚刚使用的武器技能或指令伤害提升<color=#F74848>30%</color>

400708.name: 雷火协鸣
400708.describe: 使用喷火器攻击<range type=1>纵向5格</range>范围内所有目标，造成<color=#F74848>0.6</color>倍范围伤害，然后使用电磁炮攻击相同方向，造成<color=#F74848>0.7</color>倍范围伤害，对命中的目标施加<color=#F74848>2</color>个随机减益效果，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

400741.name: 贵族遗风1
400741.SpecificEffects:
使用喷火器主动攻击后，若命中<color=#F74848>2</color>个及以上目标时，可发动<buf ID=900004>[再攻击]</buf>，攻击前可以移动<color=#F74848>2</color>格，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>1</color>次；
无法与同类<buf ID=900004>[再攻击]</buf>效果重复触发

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

400744.name: 贵族遗风2
400744.SpecificEffects: 部署<buf ID=900085>[强磁力线圈]</buf>时可以斜向设置朝向

400745.name: 贵族遗风3
400745.SpecificEffects: 对<buf ID=900085>[强磁力线圈]</buf>偏移效果命中的目标施加<color=#F74848>1</color>个随机减益效果，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合
